neighbours.label: a pronoun that opens the content clause after a speech or knowledge verb (announced it would, told me he was, let them know you care); the same pronouns as plain main-clause subjects stay low
fire: On Friday the airline announced it would cut ten routes.
Last night the coach told reporters he had no plans to leave.
The university announced its decision to drop the entrance exam.
After the storm, the town council announced they would rebuild the pier.
My sister texted me that she was running late.
In a short statement, the band announced it was splitting up.
Write to your grandparents and let them know you miss them.
During the meeting the manager told staff she would retire in June.
quiet: On Friday the airline cut ten routes and laid off staff.
Last night the coach stayed late and had no plans to leave.
The university dropped the entrance exam after years of debate.
After the storm, the town council rebuilt the pier within a month.
My sister was running late because the train was delayed.
In a short statement, the band thanked fans for twenty years.
Write to your grandparents about your new school and your friends.
During the meeting the manager handed out the new schedule.
